village_well.name: village well
village_well.appearance: In the middle of the green stands the village well, with a bucket on a fraying rope.
village_well.description: The well is ringed with mossy stones. You can't see the bottom, but you can hear water far below.
village_well.contents_text: Caught in a crack between the stones you notice {contents}.

features.name: wishing penny
features.description: A penny, green with age. Someone's wish, unclaimed.

drink: You haul up the bucket and drink. The water is cold enough to make your teeth ache.
use: You lower the bucket and haul it up again. Good clean water.
talk: You call down the well. Your voice comes back to you, sounding unsure of itself.

notice_board.name: notice board
notice_board.appearance: A notice board leans beside the well, layered with curling papers.
notice_board.description: Lost goats, a reward for a missing ring, a harvest dance. One fresh notice stands out from the rest.

do: You read the newest notice: "{beat.title}."
The notices are all old news now. Someone has drawn a little picture of you, looking heroic.

geese.name: geese
geese.description: Five geese, each one convinced it owns the village.

take: The nearest goose hisses at you with such venom that you reconsider.
touch: You reach toward a goose. It bites you. Of course it does.

innkeeper.name: #given# the innkeeper
innkeeper.appearance: {self.Name} is polishing tankards behind a counter made from an old door.
innkeeper.description: Broad-shouldered and red-cheeked, with forearms like hams and an eye that misses nothing.

do: "News?" {self.name} snorts. "#village_gossip#"

then: "And folk are saying a lot about '{beat.title}', if you're the sort to go looking for trouble."

do: {self.Name} slides a plate across the counter. "On the house. You look like you need it."
A brimming tankard appears in front of you.
{self.Name} shrugs and goes back to polishing.
{self.Name} pockets the coins with a wink. "Much obliged."

inn_bread.name: hunk of bread and cheese
inn_bread.description: Fresh bread and a wedge of sharp yellow cheese.

ale_tankard.name: tankard of ale
ale_tankard.description: Foam slides down the side of the pewter.

inn_hearth.name: hearth
inn_hearth.description: A fire big enough to roast a pig, which by the smell of it is exactly what happened earlier.

touch: Too hot! You snatch your hand back.

inn_table.name: trestle table
inn_table.appearance: A long trestle table runs down the middle of the room, scarred by years of elbows.
inn_table.description: Generations of drinkers have carved their initials into it.

candle_stub.name: candle stub
candle_stub.description: A stub of tallow candle in a clay dish.

inn_cat.name: ginger cat
inn_cat.appearance: A ginger cat sleeps on the windowsill in a patch of sun.

touch: The cat purrs like a distant thunderstorm without opening its eyes.
take: You try to pick up the cat. The cat declines, and its claws make the point.
talk: One ear twitches. That is all the answer you will get.

inn_bed.name: straw pallet
inn_bed.appearance: Your straw pallet lies rumpled in the corner where you slept.
inn_bed.description: Lumpy, but you've slept on worse.

do: Nothing else but straw.
You rummage under the pallet and find your travel pack, right where you left it.

blacksmith.name: #given# the smith
blacksmith.appearance: {self.Name} works the bellows, sparks dancing around a leather apron.
blacksmith.description: Sooty, muscular and missing the tip of one finger. They watch the forge, not you.

options.text: I need a blade for the road.
do: {self.Name} grunts, rummages in a crate, and hands you a hunting knife. "Keep the edge oiled. And bring it back in one piece."
"Horseshoes. Always horseshoes," {self.name} sighs. "One day, a sword. Just once."
"Iron doesn't lie. My hammer's been ringing wrong all week, like it's afraid of something."
The hammer resumes its rhythm.

hunting_knife.name: hunting knife
hunting_knife.description: A plain, well-balanced knife with a horn handle. Sharp enough to shave with.

anvil.name: anvil
anvil.appearance: A great black anvil squats on a stump of oak.
anvil.description: Polished bright on top by years of hammering.

push: It weighs more than you do. Considerably.

horseshoe.name: horseshoe
horseshoe.description: A new iron horseshoe. Hang it points-up for luck.

forge.name: forge
forge.description: Coals glow white-orange at its heart.

tool_rack.name: tool rack
tool_rack.appearance: A rack of tools covers the back wall.
tool_rack.description: Every tool has its place, and every place has its tool.

priest.name: Mother #given#
priest.appearance: {self.Name}, the village priest, is sweeping the floor with great concentration.
priest.description: Small, grey-haired and bright-eyed, in a robe the blue of well water.

choice.prompt: {self.Name} leans on the broom. "Peace of the Well be with you."

options.text: Will you bless me before I travel?
do: {self.Name} sprinkles a few drops of well water on your brow and murmurs a blessing. You feel steadier.
"She drew water from our well in the year of the great drought, and it has never run dry since. When the world grows dark, she said, look to the old places, for they remember."
"I pray, and the prayers come back heavier than they went."
"Walk in the light."

altar.name: altar
altar.appearance: A plain stone altar stands beneath the window.
altar.description: Plain grey stone, worn smooth at the edges by kneeling hands.

features.name: beeswax candle
features.description: A tall candle of honey-coloured beeswax.

poor_box.name: poor box
poor_box.appearance: A wooden poor box is fixed to the wall by the door.
poor_box.description: "For the Needy," says a painted label.

do: The coins clink into the box. You feel a little lighter, in a good way.
You lift the lid, feel the priest's eyes on the back of your neck, and close it again.

stained_glass.name: stained-glass window
stained_glass.description: The saint's face is serene. In her free hand she holds up a small light, and the light is pointing somewhere far away.

elder.name: Elder #given#
elder.appearance: {self.Name} sits by the cold fireplace, wrapped in a shawl.
elder.description: Ancient and sharp as a tack. Their eyes follow you everywhere.

do: "There you are," {self.name} says. "Sit. No - stand, you've no time to sit."
"I've lived a long time and I know the signs. The wells taste of iron. The birds fly the wrong way."

then: They fix you with a look. "{next.hook}"

do: "Someone must go and see. I'm too old, and the rest of them are too sensible. That leaves you."
"So. You came back." For once, {self.name} smiles. "Sit now. You've earned it."
"Well? What are you waiting for?" {self.name} snaps.

rocking_chair.name: rocking chair
rocking_chair.description: It creaks gently even when nobody is in it.

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.appearance: A sagging bookshelf holds the village's entire library.

orchard_wall.name: drystone wall
orchard_wall.description: Apples hang heavy on the far side of the wall.

do: You've already helped yourself.

spawn.name: red apple
spawn.description: A shiny red apple, liberated from the orchard.

do: You reach over the wall and help yourself to an apple. Nobody sees. Probably.

watchman.name: watchman
watchman.appearance: A watchman leans on a spear by the gate, struggling to stay awake.
watchman.description: Young, bored, and very much hoping nothing happens on their watch.

do: "Off somewhere?" The watchman yawns. "Mind how you go. Folk say all sorts."
"Quiet day," the watchman says, gratefully.
